name: jaeger_client_rpc_request_errors
title: Jaeger client RPC request errors
description: Jaeger client is experiencing a high percentage RPC HTTP errors.

source.upstream_query: 100 * sum(rate(jaeger_client_jaeger_rpc_http_requests{status_code=~"4xx|5xx"}[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace) / sum(rate(jaeger_client_jaeger_rpc_http_requests[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace) > 1 and sum(rate(jaeger_client_jaeger_rpc_http_requests[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace) > 0
source.upstream_description: Jaeger client on {{ $labels.instance }} is experiencing {{ $value | humanize }}% RPC HTTP errors.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: (100 * sum(rate(jaeger_client_jaeger_rpc_http_requests{status_code=~"4xx|5xx"}[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace) / sum(rate(jaeger_client_jaeger_rpc_http_requests[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace) > 1 and sum(rate(jaeger_client_jaeger_rpc_http_requests[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace) > 0) * 0 + 1

notes: 1% threshold mixes 4xx (client-driven, varies by application) and 5xx (infra-fault, should be ~0%) into one ratio. Adjust based on your 4xx baseline; a pure 5xx spike should still be investigated regardless of this threshold.
